resumen: Push-ups with the feet up on a bench. With the feet higher than the hands, the arms support more body weight than in a regular push-up.
ejecucion: Put your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders and your feet up on a bench.
Make a straight line from head to heels, with your abs and glutes tight.
Lower by bending your elbows until your chest nears the floor, without your hips sagging.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight, keeping your body straight.
matices: The study that measured forces in several push-ups found that raising the feet on a box loads the arms more than a regular push-up. It used 30 and 60 cm boxes; a bench falls between the two.

fuentes.titulo: Kinetic analysis of several variations of push-ups
fuentes.autor: Ebben et al., J Strength Cond Res, 2011
